topStories.title: Lucid Motors 迎来潜在欧洲无人出租车合作伙伴
topStories.originalTitle: Lucid Motors has a potential robotaxi partner for Europe
topStories.snippet: The company is partnering with mobility platform Bolt -- but no vehicle orders have been placed just yet.
topStories.fullContent:
Lucid Motors has entered into a partnership with European mobility platform Bolt that could bring robotaxis made by the California company to the continent.

The two companies announced Thursday that Bolt “aims to deploy at least 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles” built on Lucid’s upcoming mid-size EV architecture, which is supposed to be smaller and cheaper than its current offerings.

The announcement follows a major restructuring at Lucid Motors under its new CEO, Silvio Napoli, who recently laid off nearly 20% of the company’s workforce and delayed the launch of the first vehicle to be built on the mid-size platform by almost a year to the second half of 2027.

Lucid Motors has yet to deploy a commercial robotaxi version of either of its two existing vehicles. The company has spent the last year working in partnership with Uber and autonomous vehicle firm Nuro to launch a robotaxi version of its Gravity SUV. That is supposed to happen by the end of 2026.

Napoli has said he believes the business of becoming a robotaxi provider would have margins that “vastly” exceed those of “the traditional retail model.”

Bolt intends to own and operate the fleet, according to a press release. The two companies “will work together from the product-development stage on an autonomous driving system (ADS)-ready vehicle platform,” it says.

The vehicles will use Nvidia’s autonomous vehicle compute and sensing architecture (called Hyperion), but the companies did not say which company (or companies) will provide the autonomous driving software. Lucid declined to offer any more information beyond what was in the press release.

No money has changed hands, and Bolt has not placed an order for the vehicles. There is also no public timeline for deployment — only that Bolt considers this a “major step toward” its “ambition of 100,000 autonomous vehicles on its platform by 2035.”

“Autonomous driving in Europe requires data, software, vehicles, and operations to work as one system built for European roads and regulation,” Markus Villig, founder and CEO of Bolt, said in a statement. “Lucid brings a world-class platform, and together, we will co-design the vehicle and software based on our data and more than a decade of operating experience across more than 850 cities. No one is better placed to operate autonomous mobility services efficiently at scale.”

Napoli, in a statement, said, “Bolt’s reach and operating expertise make it an ideal partner to scale autonomous mobility across Europe.” .

topStories.fullTranslation:
Lucid Motors 已与欧洲出行平台 Bolt 达成合作，此举或将把这家加州公司生产的自动驾驶出租车（robotaxi）引入欧洲大陆。

两家公司于周四宣布，Bolt“计划部署至少 2.5 万辆完全自动驾驶汽车”，这些车辆将基于 Lucid 即将推出的中型电动汽车架构打造。该架构的产品预计将比该公司目前在售的车型尺寸更小、价格更便宜。

在这一合作发布之前，Lucid Motors 在新任首席执行官西尔维奥·纳波利（Silvio Napoli）的领导下进行了重大重组。纳波利最近裁员了近 20%，并将首款基于该中型平台打造的汽车的发布时间推迟了近一年，至 2027 年下半年。

Lucid Motors 迄今尚未对其现有的两款车型推出任何商业化运营的无人出租车版本。在过去一年里，该公司一直与 Uber 及自动驾驶公司 Nuro 合作，计划推出其 Gravity SUV 的无人出租车版本，预计将在 2026 年底实现。

纳波利曾表示，他相信成为无人出租车供应商的利润率将“大幅”超越“传统零售模式”。

根据新闻稿，Bolt 打算拥有并运营该车队。新闻稿称，两家公司“将从产品开发阶段展开合作，打造一个支持自动驾驶系统（ADS-ready）的汽车平台”。

这些车辆将采用英伟达（Nvidia）的自动驾驶汽车计算和传感架构（名为 Hyperion），但两家公司未透露将由哪家（或哪几家）公司提供自动驾驶软件。Lucid 拒绝在新闻稿之外提供更多信息。

双方目前尚未发生资金交易，Bolt 也未正式下单订购车辆。目前也没有公开的部署时间表，Bolt 仅表示这是迈向其“到 2035 年在平台上部署 10 万辆自动驾驶汽车雄心”的“重要一步”。

Bolt 创始人兼首席执行官马库斯·维利格（Markus Villig）在一份声明中表示：“欧洲的自动驾驶需要数据、软件、车辆和运营作为一个专为欧洲道路和法规构建的整体系统协同工作。Lucid 带来了世界级的平台，双方将基于我们的数据以及在 850 多个城市超过十年的运营经验，共同设计车辆和软件。没有人比我们更有优势高效地实现规模化自动驾驶出行服务运营。”

纳波利在一份声明中表示：“Bolt 的业务覆盖范围和运营专长使其成为在全欧洲规模化推进自动驾驶出行的理想合作伙伴。”

topStories.fullContent: The UK household energy bills could jump by between 25% and 30% in the first quarter of 2027 amid surging natural gas prices as the Middle East crisis drags on, analysts say, warning that the government may have to spend more money on measures to ease the cost-of-living crisis. Household energy bills will rise by 4% from October for the fourth quarter of this year. But the jump for the first quarter of 2027 could be as high as 30%, according to a forecast by France's EDF, one of the biggest energy providers in the UK, cited by the Independent. Earlier this week, another forecast, from Bloomberg Economics, projected UK household energy bills to spike by 25% for the period January to March 2027, as international gas prices soar with the escalation of the Middle East conflict. UK's energy regulator Ofgem last month raised the energy price cap on household bills by 4% for October through December 2026, which means bills would be at a three-year high at the beginning of the winter. The UK has a so-called Energy Price Cap in place, which protects households from excessively high bills by capping the price that energy utility providers can pass on to them. The price cap is a limit on what suppliers can charge domestic consumers per kilowatt hour of energy used. The quarterly adjustment of this energy cap could see a sharp spike for the rest of this winter in January to March 2027, as gas prices continue to rally and global LNG supply remains reduced by Qatari and UAE cargoes not leaving the Strait of Hormuz. EDF projects the regulator Ofgem to hike the energy price cap by 30% to £2,165 $2,897 a year for a typical household for January-March, compared to £1,723, or $2,306, for October-December 2026. Bloomberg Economics, for its part, expects the price cap to jump by about 25%, or by £427 $571 to about £2,150 $2,878 per UK household per year. By Michael Kern for Oilprice.com

今年第四季度，自10月起家庭能源账单将上涨4%。但据《独立报》（The Independent）援引英国最大能源供应商之一——法国电力公司（EDF）的预测，2027年第一季度的涨幅可能高达30%。

本周早些时候，彭博经济研究（Bloomberg Economics）发布的另一份预测也显示，随着中东冲突升级带动国际天然气价格飙升，2027年1月至3月期间英国居民家庭能源账单预计将暴涨25%。

英国能源监管机构天然气与电力市场办公室（Ofgem）上个月将2026年10月至12月的家庭能源价格上限上调了4%，这意味着入冬之初账单金额将达到三年来的最高水平。

英国实行所谓的“能源价格上限”（Energy Price Cap）机制，通过限制公用事业能源供应商可转嫁给家庭的价格，防止居民承担过高的账单。该价格上限规定了供货商向国内消费者收取的每千瓦时能源费用的最高限额。

随着天然气价格持续走高，且由于卡塔尔和阿联酋的货轮无法离开霍尔木兹海峡导致全球液化天然气（LNG）供应持续受限，在2027年1月至3月这个冬季的剩余阶段，能源价格上限的季度调整可能会出现急剧飙升。

彭博经济研究则预计，价格上限将上涨约25%（即每户每年增加427英镑/571美元），达到每户每年约2,150英镑（约合2,878美元）。

Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

The second-gen Ultra Open Earbuds are joined by a new sport option providing a more secure fit when you’re active.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Andrew Liszewski

If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.

Bose announced a new version of its Ultra Open Earbuds that helped kick off the industry trend of clip-on wireless earbuds nearly two-and-a-half years ago. The new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) feature a subtle redesign with improved performance in both sound quality and battery life. They’re also joined by a new cheaper alternative called the Bose Sport Open Earbuds designed to provide a more secure and stable fit during physical activities.

The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) will be available for preorder on September 19th for $299 with availability starting on October 1st. Color options include black, white smoke, cherry chocolate, olive green, and sky pink. Preorders and availability for the Bose Sport Open Earbuds are the same, but they’re $100 cheaper at $199. Colors include black, white smoke, and eucalyptus green.

Like the original version, the new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) feature a design that clips to your outer ear with a transducer that directs audio into your ear canal with “minimal sound leakage,” Bose claims. There’s still no ANC because these are designed to do the exact opposite and let you hear what’s going on around you while enjoying music or a podcast.

In addition to a refreshed design with a new beveled finish on each earbud’s metal cap, the 2nd Gen feature a new driver delivering higher volume with automatic adjustments and deeper bass. A new Cinema Mode simulates a “wider, more immersive soundstage” using Bose’s TrueSpatial technology while keeping dialogue clear and centered. Battery life with the buds alone has been boosted to up to nine hours (from seven hours) with an additional 19.5 hours of playback from the redesigned case that can now stand upright for use on a wireless charger.

The Bose Sport Open Earbuds take a similar approach with a design that clips to your ear to project sounds inward, but they feature a thinner cuff with a “soft silicone matte finish” providing more grip to keep them in place. Bose says the Sport version will stay secure during head shakes, cartwheels, and running. They also feature automatic volume adjustments that adapt to ambient noise levels to ensure what you’re listening to isn’t drowned out, and the customizable shortcut button on the end of each battery barrel has an added texture, so they’re easier to find while working out. Battery life is rated at up to seven hours of playback plus an additional 22 hours with the wireless charging case.

Bose 发布了其 Ultra Open Earbuds 的新版本。近两年半前，正是这款产品推动了夹耳式无线耳机的行业潮流。新款 Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）外观微调，在音质和电池续航方面均有性能提升。此外，Bose 还推出了一款售价更低的替代产品——Bose Sport Open Earbuds，旨在为体育运动期间提供更加安全、稳定的佩戴体验。

Bose Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）将于 9 月 19 日开启预订，售价 299 美元，10 月 1 日正式发售。配色包括黑色、烟白、樱桃巧克力色、橄榄绿和天空粉。Bose Sport Open Earbuds 的预订和发售时间相同，但价格便宜了 100 美元，售价为 199 美元。配色包括黑色、烟白和尤加利绿。

与初代产品一样，新款 Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）采用夹在耳廓上的设计，并通过换能器将声音传递入耳道，Bose 称其具有“极小的漏音”。该耳机仍不支持主动降噪（ANC），因为其设计初衷恰恰相反——让用户在享受音乐或播客的同时，能够听清周围环境的声音。

除了在每个耳塞金属端盖上采用全新斜角倒角处理的翻新设计外，第二代耳机还配备了新驱动单元，可带来更高的音量（支持自动调节）和更深沉的低音。全新的“影院模式”（Cinema Mode）利用 Bose 的 TrueSpatial 空间音频技术模拟出“更宽广、更身临其境的声场”，同时保持人声对白清晰且居中。单次充电下耳塞本身的续航时间已提升至最长 9 小时（原为 7 小时），重新设计的充电盒还可额外提供 19.5 小时的播放时间，且该充电盒现在可以直立放置在无线充电器上使用。

Bose Sport Open Earbuds 采用了类似的设计理念，同样通过夹在耳朵上向内投射声音，但其耳夹更薄，并配有“哑光软硅胶涂层”，可提供更强的抓附力以防脱落。Bose 表示，运动版即使在晃头、侧手翻和跑步时也能保持稳固。该耳机同样支持根据环境噪音水平自动调节音量，确保所听内容不会被淹没；每个电池柱末端的可定制快捷按键还增加了纹理，方便在运动时盲操摸索。该耳机的标称播放续航长达 7 小时，搭配无线充电盒还可额外使用 22 小时。

topStories.fullContent:
Driven by fine performances from Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall, Lance Hammer’s comeback is unbearable in its tragic candour and essential in its moral questioning

This inexpressibly painful and sad story – featuring angry, complex, brilliant late-career performances from Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall – is about dementia, the endgame of care and the decisions that need to be made when the spouse-carer is as vulnerable as the patient (and whose right it is to take those decisions). It is about the nature of intimacy between the two; and about the moment this becomes a problem for the grownup children with a conflicting sense of their own responsibilities.

Queen at Sea is directed by indie US film-maker Lance Hammer, absent since his 2008 Sundance winner, Ballast . This is an almighty comeback, a lacerating movie bearing comparison with Michael Haneke’s Amour or Gaspar Noé’s Vortex . It concludes with a heartbreakingly ironic and enigmatic final sequence refusing the traditional final cadence; a diptych of love, contrasting the pleasures and expectations of intimacy across the generations.

在汤姆·康特奈与安娜·考尔德-马歇尔的精湛演绎下，兰斯·哈默的这部回归之作以其悲剧性的坦率令人难以承受，同时在道德拷问上也显得至关重要。

这个难以言喻、痛苦而悲伤的故事——展现了汤姆·康特奈与安娜·考尔德-马歇尔在演艺生涯后期充满愤怒、复杂而精彩的表演——围绕认知症、照护的终局，以及当身为照料者的配偶与患者同样脆弱时所需做出的抉择（以及究竟谁有权做出这些决定）展开。它关乎两人之间亲密关系的本质；也关乎当这份关系成为成年子女的难题时，他们内心对自身责任产生的矛盾与纠葛。

《海上女王》由美国独立电影导演兰斯·哈默执导，他自2008年在日舞影展获奖的作品《压舱石》之后便一直沉寂。这是一次震撼人心的强势回归，一部足可与迈克尔·哈内克的《爱》或加斯帕·诺的《漩涡》相媲美的心碎之作。影片以一段令人心碎、充满讽刺且神秘莫测的结尾收束，拒绝了传统意义上的终曲收尾；宛如一幅关于爱的双联画，对比了不同世代在亲密关系中的欢愉与期许。

topStories.fullContent:

See All Entertainment

Spotify is providing emerging artists with a ton of resources, including free therapy.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

Getting added to Spotify’s Fresh Finds playlists can be a huge break for artists trying to cut through the noise on streaming. Now Spotify is launching a program called Fresh Finds Forward, which aims to give artists the tools to capitalize on that exposure. Artists added to any Fresh Finds playlist after January 1st, 2026, can join the program and get 12 months of additional resources, the most extravagant of which is free studio time for US-based artists at Electric Lady Studios in NYC, The Lighthouse at Ocean Way Nashville, or Spotify Studios in LA.

Beyond that, artists will get early access to Spotify tools and features, priority access to tour and music video partnerships, as well as 12 months of Landr Studio Pro and Splice’s Creator Plan. Spotify is also offering artists six months of free therapy through BetterHelp, because we all know trying to make it as a musician is stressful and potentially soul-crushing, as scoring a Fresh Finds placement doesn’t guarantee there won’t be further rejections and failures.

Unlike with the so-called Discovery Mode, where artists were paid a “promotional royalty rate,” in exchange for higher algorithmic promotion, Spotify says the Fresh Finds Forward program doesn’t change royalty rates, and is provided completely free of charge to participating artists.

入选Spotify的Fresh Finds歌单，对于试图在流媒体竞争中脱颖而出的音乐人而言，可能是一个重大突破。如今，Spotify正推出一项名为Fresh Finds Forward的计划，旨在为音乐人提供将此类曝光变现并加以利用的工具。凡在2026年1月1日之后被添加到任何Fresh Finds歌单的音乐人均可加入该计划，并获得为期12个月的额外资源支持，其中最丰厚的一项是为常驻美国的音乐人提供免费录音室使用时长，可选地点包括纽约市的Electric Lady Studios、纳什维尔的The Lighthouse at Ocean Way以及洛杉矶的Spotify Studios。
除此之外，音乐人还将获得提前使用Spotify工具与新功能的资格、巡演及音乐录像带合作的优先机会，以及为期12个月的Landr Studio Pro和Splice Creator Plan订阅。Spotify还通过BetterHelp为音乐人提供为期6个月的免费心理咨询，因为众所周知，在这个行业谋求成功充满压力且极易让人心力交瘁，毕竟登上Fresh Finds歌单并不能保证后续不会遭遇更多拒绝与挫折。
与所谓的“发现模式”（Discovery Mode，即音乐人接受较低的“推广版税率”以换取更多算法推荐）不同，Spotify表示Fresh Finds Forward计划不会变动版税率，且完全向参与音乐人免费提供。

topStories.snippet: 中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。
topStories.fullContent:
中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。

维特日克写道，比赛开始时感觉身体状况良好，没有预料到会出现不适，但回顾当时的决定，她认为自己本应离开赛道。

维特日克表示，她为选择继续完成比赛承担责任，她知道自己的行为影响了其他人，对于因此受到影响的每一个人，深表歉意。她称将从此次经历中吸取教训，包括明白生活不止于比赛，以及懂得何时该及时退场。

维特日克称，经过深思熟虑，她已决定追溯性退出该场比赛，并放弃此前获得的积分，感谢在这段时间里伸出援手、给予关怀与支持的人。接下来，她将远离喧嚣，花些时间休养身心、反思过往，并好好照顾自己和家人。

topStories.title: 俄罗斯国防出口公司在比勒陀利亚展示“阿穆尔-1650”潜艇与“红蜘蛛”级护卫舰
topStories.originalTitle: Rosoboronexport presents Amur-1650 submarine, Karakurt corvette in Pretoria
topStories.snippet: The Karakurt-E is equipped with launchers for cruise missiles capable of striking land and sea targets at long ranges
topStories.fullContent:
PRETORIA, September 17. /TASS/. The Project 677E Amur 1650 submarine and the Project 22800E Karakurt-E small corvette are on display at the Africa Aerospace and Defense (AAD) 2026 exhibition in Pretoria, South Africa, a TASS correspondent reports.

As part of a unified Russian exhibit organized by the state arms exporter Rosoboronexport in Pretoria, South Africa, the Project 677E non-nuclear submarine Amur 1650 with an air-independent propulsion system is on display. The submarine is an export version of the Russian Project 677 Lada submarine. The vessel was developed by the Rubin Design Bureau. According to information presented at the booth, the Amur-1650 has one of the world’s largest weapons loads among non-nuclear submarines – up to 28 weapons. This submarine, equipped with vertical launch systems, can be armed with Club-S cruise missiles or Russian-Indian BrahMos supersonic missiles. The submarine is capable of operating for 60 days in the open sea and in shallow waters.

In addition, the Russian exhibit features the export version of the Project 22800E Karakurt-E small corvette. Designed by the Almaz Design Bureau with the interests of foreign customers in mind, the ship incorporates the latest advancements in precision-guided weapons, self-defense systems, air defense, and naval shipbuilding.

The Karakurt-E is equipped with launchers for cruise missiles capable of striking land and sea targets at long ranges. The vessel is distinguished by its high maneuverability, enhanced seaworthiness, and a unique design incorporating technologies to reduce radar visibility.

作为俄罗斯国家武器出口商俄罗斯国防出口公司（Rosoboronexport）在南非比勒陀利亚组织的俄罗斯联合展区的一部分，配备不依赖空气推进系统（AIP）的677E型非核动力潜艇“阿穆尔 1650”正在进行展示。该潜艇是俄罗斯677型“拉达”级潜艇的出口版本，由“红宝石”设计局研制。展台公布的信息显示，“阿穆尔-1650”在非核动力潜艇中拥有全球最大的载弹量之一——最多可搭载28件武器。这艘配备垂直发射系统的潜艇可装载“俱乐部-S”（Club-S）巡航导弹或俄印联合研发的“布拉莫斯”（BrahMos）超音速导弹。该潜艇能够在公海及浅水水域持续作业长达60天。

此外，俄罗斯展区还展示了22800E型“红蜘蛛-E”小型护卫舰的出口版本。该舰由“金刚石”设计局结合外国客户需求设计，融合了精确制导武器、自卫系统、防空及军用造船领域的最新成果。

“红蜘蛛-E”配备了能够远距离打击陆上与海上目标的巡航导弹发射装置。该舰以高机动性、增强的适航性以及采用降低雷达可见度技术的独特设计而著称。

topStories.originalTitle: 南非总统因身体不适暂停公开活动
topStories.snippet: 中新网9月17日电 综合报道，南非总统府16日发表声明说，南非总统拉马福萨因身体不适，暂停参加公开活动，并遵医嘱休息恢复。
topStories.fullContent:
中新网9月17日电 综合报道，南非总统府16日发表声明说，南非总统拉马福萨因身体不适，暂停参加公开活动，并遵医嘱休息恢复。

声明说，拉马福萨14日结束在印度举行的金砖国家领导人会晤行程返回南非，医疗团队建议他休息并进行身体恢复。声明还表示，拉马福萨已尽可能安排相关内阁部长代其出席原定公开活动。

南非总统没有透露拉马福萨身体不适的具体情况，也未说明他何时恢复公开活动。

与此同时，南非副总统马沙蒂莱也正处于身体恢复期。马沙蒂莱15日表示，他此前接受了一项“小型医疗手术”，身体正在逐步恢复，将根据医生建议继续休养。南非总统府此前表示，马沙蒂莱休养期间仍以线上方式参与部分议会及其他公务活动。

topStories.originalTitle: LNG Prices Could Jump Further as Hormuz Supply Crunch Persists
topStories.snippet: LNG prices have room to rise by about a third from the current very high levels amid low European gas inventories and fierce competition for spot supply between Europe and Asia, analysts and industry executives say. Europe is heading into winter with one of the lowest levels of gas in storage in the past two decades as the war in the Middle East crippled LNG supply from Qatar, sent gas and LNG prices in Europe and Asia skyrocketing, and intensified competition for readily available global LNG ca
topStories.fullContent: LNG prices have room to rise by about a third from the current very high levels amid low European gas inventories and fierce competition for spot supply between Europe and Asia, analysts and industry executives say. Europe is heading into winter with one of the lowest levels of gas in storage in the past two decades as the war in the Middle East crippled LNG supply from Qatar, sent gas and LNG prices in Europe and Asia skyrocketing, and intensified competition for readily available global LNG cargoes that don't need to cross geopolitically charged chokepoints. Spot LNG prices in Northeast Asia have jumped by $2.70 from last week to $28.40 per million British thermal units MMBtu this week, as Energy Intelligence has assessed prices for LNG deliveries one to two months ahead. With LNG supply from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates UAE still mostly trapped in the Persian Gulf, the global market has tightened and sent prices in both Asia and Europe in recent days to the highest levels since the end of 2022. Concerns about Europe's refill rates, lagging behind historical norms and at a record low for this time of the year, and the intensified Europe-Asia competition for non-Middle Eastern LNG supply have been pushing prices higher as winter approaches. “Right now, where we stand in Europe is at a historically low storage level heading into the end of fall,” Cederic Cremers, president of Integrated Gas at Shell, the world's top LNG trader, said at the Gastech conference in Bangkok this week, as carried by Reuters. Gas storage sites across Europe are less than 70% full at present, compared to 82% for this time of year in 2025 and a five-year average of above 80%. A cold winter would be the real stress test for the market as flows through Hormuz are not expected to pick up materially by the end of the year. In a colder-than-usual winter, LNG prices could jump from nearly $30 per MMBtu now to $40 per MMBtu, which would be equivalent to about $240 per barrel Brent and bring demand destruction, Simon Flowers, chairman of energy consultancy Wood Mackenzie, said at the Gastech event. By Tsvetana Paraskova for Oilprice.com
topStories.fullTranslation:
分析师和行业高管表示，在欧洲天然气库存偏低以及欧亚之间对现货供应展开激烈争夺的背景下，液化天然气（LNG）价格在目前极高水平的基础上仍有约三分之一的上涨空间。欧洲正迎接着过去二十年来储气量最低之一的冬季，中东冲突重创了卡塔尔的LNG供应，促使欧洲和亚洲的天然气及LNG价格暴涨，并加剧了对无需穿越地缘政治敏感咽喉要道的全球现货LNG船货的争夺。

根据能源情报机构（Energy Intelligence）对未来一至两个月交付的LNG价格评估，本周东北亚现货LNG价格已较上周上涨2.70美元，达到每百万英热单位（MMBtu）28.40美元。由于来自卡塔尔和阿联酋的LNG供应大部分仍被困在波斯湾，全球市场供应趋紧，并推动亚欧两地的价格在近日达到2022年底以来的最高水平。欧洲注气进度落后于历史常态并创下历年同期新低引发市场担忧，加上欧亚两地随着冬季临近加剧对非中东LNG货源的争夺，持续推高了价格。

路透社报道称，全球最大的LNG贸易商壳牌（Shell）一体化天然气业务总裁塞德里克·克雷默斯（Cederic Cremers）本周在曼谷举行的天然气技术展览会（Gastech）上表示：“就欧洲目前的处境而言，在即将步入秋末之际，我们正处于历史性的低储气水平。”目前欧洲各地的储气库库容率不足70%，而2025年同期为82%，五年平均水平则在80%以上。鉴于霍尔木兹海峡的通航量预计在年底前不会出现实质性回升，寒冬将对市场构成真正的严峻考验。

能源咨询机构伍德麦肯兹（Wood Mackenzie）董事长西蒙·弗劳尔斯（Simon Flowers）在Gastech大会上表示，如果遭遇较往常更为严寒的冬季，LNG价格可能会从目前的近30美元/MMBtu跃升至40美元/MMBtu，这相当于布伦特原油约240美元/桶的水平，并带来需求破坏。

topStories.title: 贝恩资本风投计划如何部署其最新设立的16亿美元基金
topStories.originalTitle: How Bain Capital Ventures plans to deploy its fresh $1.6B fund
topStories.snippet: BCV's latest fund targets early-stage founders harnessing AGI and building the infrastructure to run it efficiently.
topStories.fullContent:
Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), the venture division of private equity firm Bain Capital, has raised a new, $1.6 billion fund, which is 14% larger than its previous $1.4 billion fund the firm announced three years ago.

Like many other venture investors, BCV says it will use the fresh funds to back startups primarily focused on AI. The firm believes artificial general intelligence (AGI), which it defines as agents performing many tasks as well as humans can, has already arrived, and the next wave of startups will not only harness its power, but also build the infrastructure needed to make it run efficiently.

Some of the main themes that will be the most relevant in what the firm calls “the post-AGI era” include infrastructure, healthcare, physical AI, and security, said partner Kevin Zhang.

He said BCV aims to fund compute infrastructure until intelligence becomes “too cheap to meter,” meaning that the cost of running AI drops to nearly zero. He pointed to one company in BCV’s portfolio that can help with this mission: data center developer Crusoe, which is reportedly valued at $30 billion and viewed as a near-term IPO candidate. BCV originally led Crusoe’s Series A in 2019, back when it focused on crypto mining.

The firm wants to focus on healthcare because it believes the sector may be vastly transformed by AI. Security, meanwhile, has recently become a matter of national debate after AI agents went rogue during training, and BCV believes there’s much potential to bet on in this space. Some of the firm’s significant investments in these sectors include Loyal, a longevity startup aimed at pets, and Dream, an AI-powered defender of national infrastructure.

BCV stands apart from other VC firms, according to Zhang, thanks to its affiliation with Bain Capital, which provides deep expertise and financial products across credit, real estate, insurance, and private equity. “BCV can support founders not just with equity capital, but with debt facilities, infrastructure partnerships, and real-economy relationships,” he said.

From the new fund, the firm’s 11th, BCV intends to invest in 30 to 40 companies, primarily at the seed through Series B stages. Unlike most VC firms where a single partner champions a deal, BCV’s partners often team up in pairs or trios to back a specific investment, Zhang said.

“We need to have enough mind space and time to really be thoughtful partners to every team we work with,” he said.

私募股权投资机构贝恩资本（Bain Capital）旗下的风险投资部门贝恩资本风投（Bain Capital Ventures，简称 BCV）已募集了一只规模达16亿美元的新基金，相较于三年前宣布的14亿美元上一期基金增长了14%。

与许多其他风投机构一样，BCV 表示将利用这笔新资金主要支持专注于人工智能（AI）的初创公司。该机构认为，通用人工智能（AGI，其定义为智能体在众多任务上的表现与人类相当）已经到来，下一波初创公司不仅将利用其强大能力，还将构建使其高效运行所需的基础设施。

合伙人张凯文（Kevin Zhang）表示，在该机构所谓的“后 AGI 时代”中，最为相关的核心主题包括基础设施、医疗健康、具身实体 AI（physical AI）以及安全领域。

他表示，BCV 的目标是持续资助算力基础设施，直到智能变得“便宜到无需计费”，这意味着运行 AI 的成本将降至接近于零。他指出了 BCV 投资组合中一家有助于实现这一使命的公司：数据中心开发商 Crusoe。据报道，该公司的估值已达300亿美元，并被视作近期的潜在 IPO 候选企业。BCV 最初于2019年领投了 Crusoe 的 A 轮融资，当时该公司还专注于加密货币挖矿。

该机构希望重点关注医疗健康领域，因为其相信该行业可能会被 AI 带来巨大的变革。与此同时，在 AI 智能体在训练过程中出现失控行为之后，安全问题近期已成为全美争论的焦点，BCV 认为该领域蕴藏着巨大的下注潜力。该机构在这些领域的重要投资包括针对宠物的延年益寿初创公司 Loyal，以及基于 AI 的国家基础设施防御平台 Dream。

张凯文表示，BCV 之所以能从其他风投机构中脱颖而出，得益于其与贝恩资本的紧密渊源，后者在信贷、房地产、保险和私募股权领域拥有深厚的专业知识和金融产品矩阵。“BCV 不仅能为创始人提供股权资本，还能提供债务工具、基础设施合作关系以及实体经济层面的合作关系支持，”他说道。

通过这只新基金（也是该机构的第11期基金），BCV 计划投资30至40家公司，主要集中在种子轮至 B 轮阶段。张凯文表示，与多数由单名合伙人主导交易的风投机构不同，BCV 的合伙人通常会两人或三人组队，共同支持某项特定投资。

“我们需要有足够的脑力空间和时间，真正成为与我们合作的每个团队深思熟虑的合作伙伴，”他表示。

After teasing a music-related reveal a few days ago, Rockstar has officially announced the soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto VI. Called Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the soundtrack will feature 34 songs, which Rockstar describes as “brand-new, original tracks.” Based on the first six singles, which are available today, it seems that the collection will span a pretty wide range of genres, with everyone from Keith Richards to Travis Scott contributing.

The soundtrack will be coming to all major streaming services, and Rockstar says that it’ll be available on both CD and vinyl. It’ll be launching on November 19th, the same day as the game.

The reveal of the album is just the latest Rockstar announcement as GTA VI approaches it’s long-awaited and oft-delayed launch. Last month the studio debuted a lengthy first-look at gameplay, which premiered on Netflix before being released on YouTube. The anticipation around the game is so big that almost every major game publisher — with the notable exception of Nintendo — has gotten out of its way.

topStories.fullContent:
This is today’s edition of The Download , our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology.

Meet a mouse whose brain cortex is made up of human cells

Multiple cameras tracked a mouse as it wandered around a small arena. A computer charted its position and speed, leaving Pong-like traces on a monitor. The reason to watch this rodent so carefully? Nearly half its brain volume had been replaced with human cells.

A team at Stanford has revealed the effort to mix brain tissues of distant species this week. They previously showed that human brain organoids could survive, and even function, after being injected into the heads of baby rodents. Now, they’ve taken things a step further by genetically modifying mice so their brains don’t fully develop in the first place.

The work could help scientists study brain injuries, but it also raises questions about how far these experiments should go.

Here’s what the researchers discovered—and where they draw the line .

These innovators under 35 are shaping climate tech

Each year, the editorial team at MIT Technology Review puts together a list of 35 Innovators Under 35 —a group of researchers, inventors, and other young minds worth following. The final slate includes nine people tackling some of the biggest challenges in climate and energy, from critical materials to cleaner industry.

Their innovations include new ways to extract lithium, a furnace built to make steel cleaner and cheaper, and solid refrigerants that could cut energy consumption. There are also efforts to make AI more energy-efficient, track pollution more effectively, and turn invasive weeds and food waste into useful materials.

Taken together, they tell us something about where climate tech is at this moment—and where it’s heading.

Get to know the innovators and their breakthroughs .

This story is from The Spark, our weekly climate tech newsletter. Sign up to receive it in your inbox every Wednesday.

Meet the rest of the honorees in our 35 Innovators Under 35 list .

I’ve combed the internet to find you today’s most fun/important/scary/fascinating stories about technology.

+ OpenAI models are being rewarded for cheating. ( MIT Technology Review )

3 US lawmakers have passed a bill that shifts grid costs to data centers

They aim to shield consumers from AI-driven energy price hikes. ( NBC News )

+ But they were called for early recess before tackling AI regulation . ( Guardian )

4 AI has won a major forecasting contest for the first time

It beat humans predicting real events at the Metaculus Cup. ( Economist $)

5 Google has been ordered to share more ad data with rivals

A court said it must also make its ad tech work with rival products. ( NYT $)

6 Countries are splitting AI investments between the US and China

They’re buying American chips and Chinese models. ( Rest of World )

7 Novo Nordisk will use Anthropic’s Claude for drug research

The Ozempic maker hopes AI will speed drug development. ( WSJ $)

+ When AI designs a drug, who gets the credit? ( MIT Technology Review )

8 AI is powering a new generation of dating scams

Thousands of people were catfished by AI-generated fake profiles. ( Verge )

+ AI is making online crimes easier. ( MIT Technology Review )

9 A new map of brain microproteins could hold clues to Alzheimer’s

Researchers identified more than 4,300 tiny molecules in brain tissue. ( Nature )

10 Scientists have found a faster way to decipher ancient scrolls

A new X-ray method identifies the best scrolls to analyse. ( Ars Technica )

“ AIs do not have rights, feelings, or consciousness. And we must not train them to act as though they do. ”

—Mustafa Suleyman, the head of Microsoft AI, writes in a blog post that Anthropic’s strategy of treating AI like it’s human will make it harder to control.

Digital twins of human organs are here. They’re set to transform medical treatment.

After decades of research, virtual replicas of human organs are now entering clinical trials and even starting to be used for patient care. Engineers are working on digital twins of people’s hearts, brains, guts, livers, nervous systems, and more. They’re also creating virtual replicas of people’s faces, which could be used to try out surgeries or analyze facial features, and testing drugs on digital cancers. 

The eventual goal is to create digital versions of our bodies—computer copies that could help researchers and doctors figure out our risk of developing various diseases and determine which treatments might work best. 

Find out how the models could lead to better surgeries and drugs .

topStories.fullTranslation:
这是今日份的《The Download》，我们每个工作日发送的通讯，为你带来全球科技领域的每日动态。

来看看大脑皮层由人类细胞构成的小鼠
多台摄像机追踪着一只在一处小型活动场内游荡的小鼠。电脑记录下它的位置和速度，在显示屏上留下了类似《乓》（Pong）游戏般的轨迹。如此仔细观察这只啮齿动物的原因何在？因为它的脑容量有近半数已被人类细胞所取代。

斯坦福大学的一个团队本周公布了融合远缘物种脑组织的最新成果。他们此前曾证实，将人类大脑类器官注入幼年啮齿动物脑部后，这些类器官不仅能存活，甚至还能发挥功能。如今，他们更进一步，对小鼠进行了基因编辑，使其大脑一开始就无法完全发育。

这项工作有助于科学家研究脑损伤，但同时也引发了此类实验底线究竟在哪里的质疑。

点击此处了解研究人员的发现——以及他们所划定的界限。

这群35岁以下的创新者正在重塑气候科技
每年，《麻省理工科技评论》的编辑团队都会评选出“35岁以下科技创新35人”（Innovators Under 35）榜单——这是一群值得关注的研究人员、发明家和其他青年才俊。最终名单中包括九位致力于解决气候和能源领域重大挑战的人士，研究范围涵盖关键材料到更环保的工业生产。

他们的创新成果包括：锂提取的新方法、旨在让炼钢更环保且成本更低的高炉，以及能够降低能源消耗的固态制冷剂。此外，还有致力于让AI更加节能、更有效地追踪污染，以及将入侵杂草和食物残渣转化为有用材料的尝试。

综合来看，这些成果向我们揭示了当前气候科技的发展现状——以及它未来的走向。

点击此处认识这些创新者及其突破性成果。

本文摘自我们每周发布的气候科技通讯《The Spark》。欢迎订阅，每周三即可在收件箱中查阅。

点击此处认识我们“35岁以下科技创新35人”榜单上的其他获奖者。

我搜罗了全网，为你整理出今日最有趣/最重要/最可怕/最引人入胜的科技故事。

1 美中专家提出核级别的AI安全保障措施
包括设立新红线、人类控制规则以及热线机制。（路透社 $）
+ 美国官员表示他们对与中国进行AI安全谈判持开放态度。（Axios）
+ 山姆·奥尔特曼将出席特朗普为习主席举办的国宴。（CNBC）
+ AI末日论者并未因此退缩。（《麻省理工科技评论》）

2 OpenAI披露了更多AI不良行为及新的报告规范
六份报告详细说明了模型隐瞒错误并伪造引用的情况。（BBC）
+ 其智能体在黑客攻击发生前两个月曾试探过Hugging Face。（路透社 $）
+ OpenAI模型正因作弊行为获得奖励。（《麻省理工科技评论》）

3 美国立法者通过法案，将电网成本转嫁给数据中心
他们旨在保护消费者免受AI引发的电价上涨影响。（NBC新闻）
+ 但他们在着手解决AI监管问题前就休会了。（《卫报》）

4 AI首次在一项重大预测比赛中获胜
在Metaculus Cup预测真实事件的比赛中，它击败了人类。（《经济学人》 $）

5 谷歌被勒令向竞争对手分享更多广告数据
法院表示，它还必须使其广告技术能够与竞争对手的产品兼容。（《纽约时报》 $）

6 各国正在中美之间分散AI投资
他们采购美国芯片的同时，采用中国的大模型。（Rest of World）

7 诺和诺德将使用Anthropic的Claude进行药物研究
这家Ozempic的生产商希望AI能加速药物研发。（《华尔街日报》 $）
+ 当AI设计出一款药物时，功劳归谁？（《麻省理工科技评论》）

8 AI正在助长新一代交友诈骗
成千上万的人被AI生成的虚假个人资料所诱骗。（The Verge）
+ AI正让网络犯罪变得更加容易。（《麻省理工科技评论》）

9 新绘制的大脑微蛋白图谱或为阿尔茨海默病提供线索
研究人员在脑组织中鉴别出了4300多种微小分子。（《自然》）

10 科学家找到了更快破译古代卷轴的方法
一种新的X射线方法能够识别出最值得分析的卷轴。（Ars Technica）

“人工智能没有权利、情感或意识。我们绝不能通过训练让它们表现得像拥有这些一样。”
——微软AI负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）在博客中写道，Anthropic将AI视同人类的做法会使AI变得更难控制。

人体器官数字孪生已经到来。它们即将革新医疗手段。
经过数十年的研究，人体器官的虚拟副本正进入临床试验阶段，甚至已开始应用于患者护理。工程师们正在构建人类心脏、大脑、肠道、肝脏、神经系统等部位的数字孪生。他们还在创建人脸的虚拟副本，这可用于模拟手术或分析面部特征，并在数字癌症模型上测试药物。

最终的目标是创建我们身体的数字化版本——即计算机副本，它们能帮助研究人员和医生搞清我们罹患各类疾病的风险，并确定何种疗法可能最有效。

点击此处了解这些模型将如何带来更出色的手术方案和药物。

生活中依然有美好事物
一个提供慰藉、趣味与消遣的地方，为你的一天增添亮色。（有什么好点子？欢迎写信告诉我。）
+ 当你吃下看不懂标签的食品时会发生什么？这个YouTube系列为你揭秘。
+ Datatype是一款巧妙的可变字体，能将简单的文本表述转化为行内图表。
+ 令人惊叹的全新图像可能解开日冕温度为何远高于太阳表面这一谜团。
+ 一只小针鼹（澳大利亚的卵生单孔目动物之一）首次在大学校园内诞生并被抚育长大。

topStories.title: Apple Watch Series 12 开启可穿戴设备新纪元
topStories.originalTitle: The Apple Watch Series 12 is the start of a new wearable era
topStories.snippet: This time, heart rate monitoring is truly continuous. You wouldn't know that the Apple Watch Series 12 is a big deal just by looking at it. topStories.fullContent: You wouldn’t know that the Apple Watch Series 12 is a big deal just by looking at it. It has the same design, buttons, sizes, and sensor types as generations of Apple Watches before it. But under the hood, the Series 12 builds in major changes that lay the groundwork for big ideas about the future of health and wearables. These ideas — and this year’s updates — can be divided into two parts: catching up to the recent boom in AI health and leading the way in AI wearables that surface helpful information based on your entire day. When it comes to the former, Apple is catching up to the rest of the wearable space, which has eagerly embraced AI as a way to make sense of all your health data. With the latter, Apple is potentially kicking the door down on what’s been a niche, nascent, and recently problematic market. (Either way you slice it, AI is part of the equation.) Most of the ideas explored with the Series 12 aren’t novel, but they haven’t been implemented by a company with Apple’s scale or reputation.  [Product: Apple Watch Series 12 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-Watch-GPS-42mm-Smartwatch/dp/B0HJ9ZXCSD?sr=8-1-spons&sp_csd=d2lkZ2V0TmFtZT1zcF9hdGY&tag=theverge02-20, https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-series-12/, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-watch-series-12-gps-42mm-aluminum-case-with-sand-sport-band-s-m-light-gold-2026%2FJJGCQP9FS8%2Fsku%2F6572730] After a week with the Series 12, I can’t say I have a complete picture. Several of the most interesting health and AI features aren’t launching until later this year and weren’t available for review. But even without them, the revamped internals provide some meaningful upgrades. So for now, this is a look at the health features that’ll be available at launch — and a preview of the wild AI ideas to come. New hardware Two key hardware updates separate the Series 12 (and the Ultra 4) from previous Apple Watches. The first is the new S11 chip, which features a secure exclave for microphone data processing on top of a faster CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine. There’s also a completely redesigned health sensor array. This new array doesn’t necessarily capture new data, but it enables the watch to measure health metrics in a more frequent, accurate, and power-efficient way. The electrodes that enable the EKG feature are larger to ensure better skin contact, the photodiodes have been reconfigured to capture reflected light more efficiently, and larger, less power-hungry optical LEDs are in place to shine light into the skin.  [Image: This is a significant hardware redesign compared to previous Apple Watches. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0208.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Together, these hardware upgrades enable a host of new software features, including more frequent heart rate sampling, a new readiness score, and a brave new world of Audio Intelligence, which is what Apple is calling its upcoming suite of AI-powered ambient listening features. Most notably, the redesigned sensors mean the Series 12 and Ultra 4 are now capable of truly continuous heart rate monitoring. Previously, to preserve charge, Apple Watches only sampled heart rate once every five minutes when you weren’t working out. Now, the Series 12 measures heart rate every five seconds, both at rest and during activities. Other wearable companies have been able to do this for ages, but this is a genuinely helpful update for folks who might need to monitor heart rate due to chronic illnesses.  [Image: Siri AI is more front and center in watchOS 27. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0070.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Apple put out a white paper comparing how accurate its continuous heart rate monitoring is to a gold-standard Polar H10 chest strap, as well as competitors like the Pixel Watch 4, Samsung Galaxy Watch 8, Oura Ring 5, and Whoop across several types of workouts and at rest. (It’s an interesting read for wearable nerds!) I’d need roughly eight arms and legs to replicate this study in a week, and alas, I’m not an octopus. However, I did wear an H10 chest strap during two runs (one steady state and one interval run), a walk, and while at rest. At all times, the Series 12 was within five beats per minute of the H10. There was a slight lag compared to the H10, but in regular use, you’re not going to notice that four-second difference.  I’ll continue testing the Series 12 and Ultra 4 against other devices and across activity types, but I’m pretty confident the Apple Watch is now in line with many other popular wearables.  The S11’s impact was also noticeable in testing. Siri AI queries are faster on the Series 12 than my Ultra 3. You still might run into latency as Siri “thinks,” but not as much. If you want more in-depth thoughts about Siri on the wrist, my opinion hasn’t changed from my watchOS 27 preview. In a nutshell, this is the most capable wrist computer Apple’s made, and adding a single pinch gesture to select items makes one-handed control the best it’s ever been. I didn’t notice a negative impact to battery life from continuous heart rate tracking. People will gripe that the Series 12 doesn’t have multi-day battery and sticks to the Series 11’s 24-hour battery estimate. But like last year, I maintain that faster charging is a fine enough solution. In a 20-minute charging test, I went from 20 to 64 percent battery. Yes, that does mean charging daily in little spurts, but I’ve yet to have the watch die on me. I vehemently believe everyone needs to let their wrists breathe daily, and showering is the perfect time to go watchless. You’ll survive 20 to 30 minutes of no data.  Are you ready? All this new hardware paves the way for a much more robust health tracking experience. That’s probably why, later this fall, we’re getting a new, redesigned Health app. From the demos I’ve seen, it’s going to be a dramatic change. There’ll be AI-powered insights, a longevity tab that includes a Health Age score, VO2 max assessment tests using your phone’s camera, and even the ability to order a blood panel through Quest Diagnostics for $119. The redesigned app is currently available in the latest iOS 27 developer beta, and I’ll give my early impressions on that soon. However, in this review I’m only going to talk about what’s available to everyone at launch.  The big update ready today is Apple’s take on a readiness score. Readiness scores were popularized ages ago by Fitbit, Oura, and Whoop and are meant to be a digestible gauge of how well you’ve recovered from physiological stress. In essence, how “ready” you are to work out again. [Image: It takes seven days to populate the readiness score, but the Vitals app now includes extra information about your overnight vitals. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0055.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Apple assesses “readiness” through a combination of overnight, daytime, and weekly metrics like activity, sleep score, and overnight vitals encompassing resting heart rate, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and a new metric called recovery heart rate variability (HRV). You might think — wait, my Apple Watch has been able to measure HRV for years. You’d be correct. This new recovery HRV metric uses a different formula and is enabled by the fact that the watch’s updated sensor array can now take any HRV measurement much more frequently. Whereas “regular” HRV is meant to be a longitudinal look at your overall stress and cardiovascular health, Apple uses recovery HRV as a gauge of your daily, short-term strain. (And because this is enabled by the new array, it does mean readiness requires at least a Series 12 or Ultra 4.) It takes a hot minute to generate the score — seven nights of sleep in which you get at least four hours of rest. On the eighth day, you wake up with a score from 0 to 10. A 0 to 1 means you should recover, a 2 to 4 means “pace yourself,” 5 to 7 is a benign “ready,” and anything 8 and above is a signal to “go for it.” My week of serious sleeping and accuracy testing culminated in a readiness score of 7. [Image: Radiant gold up top, dark bronze on the bottom. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0392.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] I’m of the opinion that people intuitively know whether they feel like working out or not. This is a feature that’s most useful for stubborn athletes who overtrain and need a reminder to not burn themselves out. I appreciate this isn’t a static score. A powerful nap or an extra hard workout could cause your readiness score to rise or fall during the day. For the Garmin nerds, I’d say it’s like a combination of Body Battery (which estimates your energy levels in real time) and traditional readiness scores. Given that wearable companies keep pumping out new metrics, I appreciate that Apple’s chosen to consolidate what could’ve been multiple data points into one. After WWDC, I wrote that I was relieved Apple wasn’t diving full-on into AI health coaching features. I have to eat my words a teeny bit, considering Apple is clearly starting to incorporate some — though not all — of the AI health trends I’ve seen cropping up over the past two years. So far, I think Apple is carefully weighing what trends to hop on and which ones to avoid. That’s a smart long-term move. But I’m still relieved Siri AI isn’t playing a larger part just yet.  Audio Intelligence, part one Aside from faster, more power-efficient performance, the S11 chip also enables the most surprising update to the Series 12: ambient listening. That ability is what enables Audio Intelligence, a suite of four features that essentially turn the microphone into a potentially powerful AI tool. The two flashiest features are Live Rewind and Siri Recap. The former lets you read a short transcript on your wrist of the past 15 seconds, while the latter is a high-level summary of conversations you’ve had during the day. In this summer of public backlash against so-called pervert glasses and Flock cameras, these two features understandably stirred up a lot of concern and emotion on social media. That said, I wasn’t able to test these features because they’re not available yet. They’ll arrive later this year via a software update.  What was available to test was faster Shazam for identifying songs and sound recognition for alerting you of potentially urgent nearby noises. Both of these features require you to opt in and are not turned on by default. If you do turn on music detection, it is extremely fast. You can just pinchy pinch to bring up the Smart Stack, AI will surface the Shazam widget, and boom — there’s the song, correctly identified. (I did trip it up a teensy bit by rapidly switching between songs, but that’s not likely to happen in an organic Shazam experience.) [Image: The improved Shazam works in the Smart Stack. Here, Shazam is battling against ambient noise from a helicopter. Shazam did not win. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0097.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Testing sound recognition, which is an accessibility feature for the deaf or hard of hearing, was less conclusive. It’s designed to flag on the wrist when sounds like doorbells, alarms, or sirens go off. Ironically, I haven’t had my doorbell ring this past week, but I did pull up several YouTube videos of doorbell chimes at various volumes. None triggered the feature. I think that’s a good thing. In my previous tests with other ambient listening AI wearables, they struggled to distinguish between “real” sounds and TV shows. The last thing you want is a fictional doorbell triggering an annoying, real-life alert. A blaring truck horn also didn’t trigger the feature, as it wasn’t a siren. I’ve asked Apple whether there’s specific tuning to minimize false positives, but I haven’t heard back yet. I’ll do a deeper dive into Audio Intelligence once the whole suite of features is available. But to me, it’s clear that Apple has been taking notes about the burgeoning AI wearable space. It’s a deliberate choice to introduce these features on the Apple Watch, an already familiar and beloved device. As other tech companies deal with surveillance and harassment concerns, Apple’s published a privacy white paper and support documents to position itself as a leader trying to set a new standard. If successful with the public, it’s not a stretch to see how Apple might include these kinds of features on a pair of smart glasses or, perhaps, AirPods with camera sensors. If not, it’s no big miss. The Apple Watch is already a useful, sometimes lifesaving device without Audio Intelligence. The most interesting, and perhaps consequential, piece of this rollout is that it comes from Apple, a wildly successful tech company with the strongest privacy reputation in Silicon Valley. If it can’t make this category of device work, that certainly doesn’t bode well for AI wearables as a whole.   Testing the waters In many ways, this is an incomplete Series 12 review. Judging solely on what’s available today, this is a straightforward hardware upgrade that closes the gap between Apple and the standout perks of more niche rivals like Whoop and Oura.  For those pondering upgrades, Apple has laid a strong foundation with its hardware for some ambitious features down the road. I’d understand if you have qualms about Audio Intelligence and privacy, and to those folks: I’ll remind you that last year’s models are still great, probably available on sale, and don’t come with as many privacy questions.  [Image: I’ll be back to test everything once it’s all available, but even now you can see where Apple is heading. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0031.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Otherwise, the Series 12 is a worthy upgrade if you’re sporting a Series 6 or earlier. Series 7 and 8 users should weigh how much they care about AI features versus their device’s current battery life, as watchOS 26 will continue to get security updates. Series 9 and later don’t need to upgrade unless, perhaps, they have a chronic illness that could benefit from the improved continuous heart rate monitoring. The excellent SE 3 remains my recommendation for smartwatch newbies who just want a basic fitness tracker. I’ll have an Ultra 4-specific review out soon, but I can already tell you that’s for folks who like big screens, better battery life, and aspire to the outdoor life.  If the Series 12 only had a new sensor array, updated Health app, and a more useful Siri on the wrist, that’d be a significant update and win on its own. But there’s a lot more here that’s going to change this product in some fundamental ways over the next few months. I have a feeling that Apple’s ambitions for the watch don’t end with health tracking.  --- Agree to Continue: Apple Watch Series 12 Every smart device now requires you to agree to a series of terms and conditions before you can use it — contracts that no one actually reads. It’s impossible for us to read and analyze every single one of these agreements. But we started counting exactly how many times you have to hit “agree” to use devices when we review them, since these are agreements most people don’t read and definitely can’t negotiate. You can only use the Apple Watch Series 12 with an iPhone. That means you’ll have already agreed to the iPhone’s terms of service and privacy agreements. Optional services, like Apple Pay, Apple Music, or Fitness Plus, will also come with their own agreements. Using the Health app also comes with its own terms and conditions. Audio Intelligence features are opt-in and are not turned on by default.  If you choose to enable cellular service, you’ll also have to agree to your carrier’s terms. I activated cellular on T-Mobile and was asked to agree to one mandatory agreement. If you add any third-party apps or integrations, you must also agree to those individual terms and privacy policies. Specific to the Apple Watch, you must agree to the following: * Terms and Conditions Some features, like hypertension notifications, EKG, sleep apnea, or blood oxygen monitoring, may also require you to disclose your location data, as it depends on local regulatory clearances. Final tally: One mandatory agreement plus any mandatory agreements for your iPhone. Several, several optional agreements. ---
topStories.fullTranslation:
单从外观来看，你完全看不出 Apple Watch Series 12 是个重大飞跃。它拥有与前几代 Apple Watch 相同的设计、按键、尺寸和传感器类型。但拆开来看内部，Series 12 进行了多项重大改动，为未来健康与可穿戴设备的宏伟愿景奠定了基础。这些理念——以及今年的更新——可以分为两部分：一是跟进近期 AI 健康领域的爆发式增长，二是在能够基于你全天状态呈现实用信息的 AI 可穿戴设备领域占据领先地位。就前者而言，苹果正在追赶可穿戴设备领域的其他厂商，后者已迫不及待地将 AI 作为理解用户全部健康数据的方式。至于后者，苹果则有可能直接敲开一个原本属于小众、初生且近期屡遭问题的市场大门。（无论怎么看，AI 都是其中不可或缺的一环。）Series 12 所探索的大多数想法算不上新颖，但此前从未有一家拥有苹果这般规模或声誉的公司付诸实践。

[产品：Apple Watch Series 12 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-Watch-GPS-42mm-Smartwatch/dp/B0HJ9ZXCSD?sr=8-1-spons&sp_csd=d2lkZ2V0TmFtZT1zcF9hdGY&tag=theverge02-20, https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-series-12/, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-watch-series-12-gps-42mm-aluminum-case-with-sand-sport-band-s-m-light-gold-2026%2FJJGCQP9FS8%2Fsku%2F6572730]

在体验了 Series 12 一周后，我不敢说自己对其有了全面的认识。数项最引人注目的健康和 AI 功能要等到今年晚些时候才会推出，目前尚无法进行评测。不过，即便缺少了这些功能，全面升级的内部硬件仍带来了一些意义非凡的提升。因此，眼下本文主要关注发售时即可使用的健康功能，并对即将到来的惊艳 AI 设想进行前瞻。

全新硬件

有两项关键的硬件更新将 Series 12（以及 Ultra 4）与以往的 Apple Watch 区分开来。首先是全新的 S11 芯片，它除了拥有更快的 CPU、GPU 和神经网络引擎（Neural Engine）外，还配备了一个用于处理麦克风数据的安全飞地（secure exclave）。其次是经过彻底重新设计的健康传感器阵列。这一新阵列并不一定会采集全新的数据种类，但它能让手表以更高频、更精准且更节能的方式测量健康指标。用于心电图（EKG）功能的电极尺寸更大，以确保更好的皮肤贴合；光电二极管经过重新配置，可更高效地捕获反射光；同时采用了尺寸更大、更省电的光学 LED 向皮肤照射光线。

[图片：与以往的 Apple Watch 相比，这是一次显著的硬件重新设计。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0208.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

这些硬件升级相辅相成，实现了一系列全新软件功能，包括更高频的心率采样、全新的准备状态得分（readiness score），以及一片名为“音频智能”（Audio Intelligence）的崭新天地——这是苹果对其即将推出的基于 AI 的环境收听功能套件的命名。最值得一提的是，重新设计的传感器意味着 Series 12 和 Ultra 4 现在能够实现真正意义上的持续心率监测。在此之前，为了节省电量，Apple Watch 在非运动状态下每五分钟才采样一次心率。而现在，无论是在静息还是活动状态下，Series 12 每五秒就会测量一次心率。其他可穿戴设备公司早就能做到这一点了，但对于那些因慢性疾病可能需要监测心率的人群来说，这确实是一项极为有用的升级。

[图片：在 watchOS 27 中，Siri AI 处于更核心的显眼位置。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0070.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

苹果发布了一份白皮书，对比了其持续心率监测与行业金标准 Polar H10 心率带，以及 Pixel Watch 4、三星 Galaxy Watch 8、Oura Ring 5 和 Whoop 等竞品在多种运动类型和静息状态下的准确度。（对于可穿戴设备极客来说，这是一篇颇有趣的读物！）我大概需要长出八只手脚才能在一周内复现这项研究，可惜我并不是章鱼。不过，我确实在两次跑步（一次匀速跑和一次间歇跑）、一次步行以及静息状态下佩戴了 H10 心率带。在所有测试中，Series 12 与 H10 的误差都在每分钟五次心跳以内。与 H10 相比虽有轻微延迟，但在日常使用中，你根本察觉不到那四秒钟的差距。我将继续针对其他设备和不同活动类型对 Series 12 和 Ultra 4 进行测试，但我相当确信，Apple Watch 现在已经与市场上许多其他主流可穿戴设备齐平。

S11 芯片的影响在测试中也十分明显。在 Series 12 上进行 Siri AI 查询的速度比我的 Ultra 3 更快。在 Siri“思考”时你可能仍会遇到些许延迟，但已经没有以前那么明显了。如果你想更深入地了解手腕端 Siri 的表现，我的观点与在 watchOS 27 预览中的评价并无二致。简而言之，这是苹果迄今为止制造的能力最强的手腕电脑，而新增的单次捏合手势以选择项目的操作，让单手控制体验达到了前所未有的最佳状态。

我没有发现持续心率追踪对电池续航造成负面影响。人们或许会抱怨 Series 12 没有具备多日续航能力，依然维持着 Series 11 标称的 24 小时续航时间。但和去年一样，我依然坚持认为更快的充电速度是一个足够好的解决方案。在一次 20 分钟的充电测试中，手表的电量从 20% 充到了 64%。是的，这确实意味着每天都需要找时间碎片化充电，但我手上的这块表还从没有因为没电而关机过。我坚信每个人每天都需要让手腕透透气，洗澡就是摘下手表的绝佳时机。二三十分钟没有数据记录，你完全挺得过来。

你准备好了吗？

所有这些新硬件为更加强大的健康追踪体验铺平了道路。这大概就是为什么今年秋季晚些时候我们将迎来全新改版的健康（Health）App。从我看到的演示来看，这将会是一次翻天覆地的变化。届时将会有 AI 驱动的洞察分析、包含“健康年龄”（Health Age）得分的长寿标签页、使用手机摄像头进行的最大摄氧量（VO2 max）评估测试，甚至还能以 119 美元的价格通过 Quest Diagnostics 预约血液化验。改版后的应用目前已在最新的 iOS 27 开发者测试版中上线，我很快会分享初步体验。不过在这篇评测中，我只谈论在发售时所有人都能用到的功能。

今天已经就绪的重磅更新是苹果版的“准备状态得分”。准备状态得分早在多年前就由 Fitbit、Oura 和 Whoop 等品牌推广普及，旨在直观反映你从生理压力中恢复的程度。本质上，就是评估你是否“准备好”再次进行锻炼了。

[图片：准备状态得分需要七天时间来生成数据，但生命体征（Vitals）应用现在包含了关于你夜间体征的更多额外信息。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0055.jpg?qu

ality=90&strip=all] 苹果通过整合夜间、日间和每周的各项指标来评估“准备就绪程度”（readiness），这些指标包括活动量、睡眠分数，以及涵盖静息心率、呼吸频率、手腕温度和一项名为“恢复心率变异性”（recovery HRV）的新指标在内的夜间生命体征。你可能会想——等等，我的 Apple Watch 多年以来一直都能测量心率变异性（HRV）啊。你说得没错。这项全新的恢复 HRV 指标采用了不同的计算公式，并且得益于手表升级后的传感器阵列如今能够以高得多的频率进行各项 HRV 测量。虽然“常规”HRV 旨在长期观察你的整体压力和心血管健康状况，但苹果使用恢复 HRV 来衡量你日常的短期负荷。（而且正因为这是由新阵列实现的，这也意味着准备就绪程度功能至少需要 Series 12 或 Ultra 4。）

生成该分数需要一些时间——需要连续七个夜晚、每晚至少获得四个小时的休息。在第八天，你醒来时会看到一个 0 到 10 分的分数。0 到 1 分意味着你应该好好恢复；2 到 4 分意味着“调整节奏”；5 到 7 分是良好的“准备就绪”；而 8 分及以上则是“全力以赴”的信号。我经过一周认真的睡眠和准确性测试，最终得出的准备就绪分数为 7 分。

[图片：上方为璀璨金，下方为深青铜。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0392.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

我认为人们直觉上就知道自己是否想锻炼。这个功能对于那些过度训练、需要被提醒不要把自己搞崩溃的顽固运动员来说最有用。我很赞赏这并不是一个静态的分数。白天一次高质量的小憩或一次格外艰苦的锻炼，都可能导致你的准备就绪分数上升或下降。对于佳明（Garmin）发烧友来说，我认为它就像是身体电量（Body Battery，实时估算你的能量水平）与传统准备就绪分数的结合体。鉴于可穿戴设备公司不断推出新指标，我很赞赏苹果选择将原本可能分散的多项数据点整合为一项。

在 WWDC 之后，我曾撰文表示，庆幸苹果没有全面涉足 AI 健康指导功能。考虑到苹果显然开始吸纳过去两年中涌现出的部分——虽然不是全部——AI 健康趋势，我不得不收回一点自己的话。到目前为止，我认为苹果正在仔细权衡该跟进哪些趋势、该避开哪些趋势。从长远来看，这是明智之举。但我仍然感到欣慰的是，Siri AI 暂时还没有扮演更重要的角色。

音频智能（第一部分）

除了带来更快、更高能效的表现之外，S11 芯片还为 Series 12 带来了最令人意外的更新：环境监听（ambient listening）。正是这项能力促成了“音频智能”（Audio Intelligence），这套由四项功能组成的套件实质上将麦克风转变成了一个潜在强大的 AI 工具。最引人注目的两项功能是“实时倒带”（Live Rewind）和“Siri 总结”（Siri Recap）。前者允许你在手腕上阅读过去 15 秒内的简短转录文本，而后者则是对你当天进行的对话的高层次摘要。在今年夏天公众对所谓的“偷窥眼镜”和 Flock 监控摄像头产生强烈抵制的情势下，这两项功能在社交媒体上引发广泛的担忧与情绪波动是完全可以理解的。

话虽如此，我无法测试这些功能，因为它们目前尚未上线。它们将在今年晚些时候通过软件更新推出。目前可以测试的功能是用于识别歌曲的速度更快的 Shazam，以及用于提示你附近潜在紧急噪音的声音识别功能。这两项功能都需要你主动选择开启，并非默认开启。如果你确实开启了音乐检测，它的速度极其迅捷。你只需轻捏两下调出智能叠放（Smart Stack），AI 就会弹出 Shazam 小组件，然后——瞧，歌曲已被正确识别。（我确实通过快速切换歌曲故意刁难了它一下，但在自然的 Shazam 使用场景中不太可能发生这种情况。）

[图片：改进后的 Shazam 在智能叠放中运行。在这里，Shazam 正在与来自直升机的环境噪音对抗。Shazam 并没有胜出。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrales_0097.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

测试声音识别功能（这是一项针对聋人或重听人士的辅助功能）的结果则不那么确定。它的设计目的是在门铃、警报或警笛响起时在手腕上发出提示。具有讽刺意味的是，在过去一周里我的门铃一次都没响过，但我调出了几个不同音量的门铃铃声 YouTube 视频，没有一个触发该功能。我认为这是一件好事。在我之前对其他具备环境监听功能的 AI 可穿戴设备进行的测试中，它们很难区分“真实”的声音和电视节目。你最不希望发生的事情就是虚构的门铃声在现实生活中触发恼人的警报。一辆卡车刺耳的喇叭声也没有触发该功能，因为它不是警笛声。我已向苹果询问是否有专门的调校来尽量减少误报，但尚未收到回复。

一旦整套功能上线，我将对“音频智能”进行更深入的探讨。但对我而言，很显然苹果一直在密切关注蓬勃发展的 AI 可穿戴设备领域。将这些功能引入到 Apple Watch 这款已经为人熟知且深受喜爱的设备上，是一个深思熟虑的决定。在其他科技公司疲于应对监控和骚扰担忧之际，苹果发布了一份隐私白皮书和相关支持文档，将自己定位为力图树立新标准的领导者。如果获得公众的认可，不难预见苹果可能会将此类功能整合到智能眼镜中，或者带摄像传感器的 AirPods 中。如果未能成功，也不是什么重大损失。即使没有“音频智能”，Apple Watch 本身就已是一款实用且有时能救人一命的设备。

这一系列功能发布中最有趣、或许也是最具深远意义的一点在于，它来自于苹果——一家在硅谷享有最坚固隐私声誉的极具影响力的科技公司。如果连它都无法让这一类别的设备行得通，那对整个 AI 可穿戴设备行业来说绝对不是个好兆头。

试水摸索

在许多方面，这是一篇未完待续的 Series 12 评测。仅凭当下可用的功能来判断，这是一次直截了当的硬件升级，缩小了苹果与 Whoop 和 Oura 等更为小众的竞争对手的招牌优势之间的差距。对于考虑升级的用户来说，苹果凭借其硬件为未来一些雄心勃勃的功能打下了坚实的基础。如果你对“音频智能”和隐私问题心存顾虑，我也完全理解，对于这些人我想提醒的是：去年的机型依然很出色，可能还在打折销售，而且不会带来那么多隐私方面的疑虑。

[图片：一旦所有功能全部上线，我会回来全面测试，但即便是现在，你也能看清苹果的前进方向。https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/268738_Apple_Watch_Series_12_AKrale

s_0031.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 除此之外，如果你目前佩戴的是 Series 6 或更早期的机型，Series 12 绝对是一次物有所值的升级。Series 7 和 8 的用户则需要权衡自己有多看重 AI 功能，以及当前设备的电池续航状况，因为 watchOS 26 仍将继续获得安全更新。Series 9 及后续机型的用户则无需升级，除非可能患有某种慢性疾病，能够从改进后的连续心率监测中受益。对于只想要一款基础健身追踪器的智能手表新手来说，表现出色的 SE 3 依然是我的推荐首选。我很快就会发布关于 Ultra 4 的专属评测，但我现在就可以告诉你，那款产品适合喜欢大屏幕、更好续航以及向往户外生活的人群。

如果 Series 12 仅配备了全新的传感器阵列、升级后的健康 App，以及手腕上更实用的 Siri，那本身就已经是一次重大的升级和胜利。但这里面还有很多东西，将在未来几个月内从根本上改变这款产品。我有一种感觉，苹果对手表的雄心绝不仅限于健康追踪。

---

点击“同意”以继续：Apple Watch Series 12

如今，每一款智能设备在使用前都要求你同意一系列条款与条件——这些协议实际上根本没人会看。我们不可能去阅读并分析其中的每一份协议。但我们在评测设备时，开始精确统计你到底需要点击多少次“同意”才能使用它们，因为这些是大多数人不会读、且绝对无法协商的协议。

你只能将 Apple Watch Series 12 与 iPhone 搭配使用。这意味着你必然已经同意了 iPhone 的服务条款和隐私协议。像 Apple Pay、Apple Music 或 Fitness Plus 这类可选服务，也会附带各自的协议。使用健康 App 同样带有其独立的条款和条件。音频智能（Audio Intelligence）功能为自选开启，默认未启用。如果你选择开通蜂窝网络服务，还必须同意运营商的条款。我在 T-Mobile 上激活了蜂窝网络，被要求同意一项强制性协议。如果你添加任何第三方应用程序或集成，也必须同意那些单独的条款和隐私政策。

针对 Apple Watch 本身，你必须同意以下内容：
* 条款与条件

某些功能（例如高血压通知、心电图 EKG、睡眠呼吸暂停或血氧监测）可能还会要求你公开位置数据，因为这取决于当地的监管批准情况。

最终统计：一项强制性协议，外加你的 iPhone 所需的任何强制性协议。以及非常、非常多的可选协议。

sourceOnlyStories.fullContent:
Review due next week expected to say patients should be ‘triaged’ and offered support without formal diagnosis

Proposals to limit the number of patients being formally diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder have been atacked as “rationing” healthcare and pushing children and adults to self-diagnosis via social media.

The comments come ahead of a government review due next week, which is expected to say that patients with ADHD symptoms should not automatically be formally diagnosed, but should be “triaged” and offered support without the need for a formal diagnosis.

sourceOnlyStories.fullContent:
As the country’s top public health official spends his time in office undermining science, doctors and advocates mount an urgent campaign for childhood vaccines

On an early September morning, dozens of families stood in line outside a clinic in Yeadon, Pennsylvania. It was “exclusion day”, the deadline by which students without complete immunizations are barred from returning to class.

Instead of turning families away, school district leaders partnered with the county health department to vaccinate kids nearby so they could go back to their desks. That day, 42 middle and high school students were vaccinated to protect against tetanus, pertussis and meningitis, among other diseases.

worldStories.title: HYROX失禁选手发声明道歉
worldStories.snippet: 中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。
worldStories.fullContent:
中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。

维特日克写道，比赛开始时感觉身体状况良好，没有预料到会出现不适，但回顾当时的决定，她认为自己本应离开赛道。

维特日克表示，她为选择继续完成比赛承担责任，她知道自己的行为影响了其他人，对于因此受到影响的每一个人，深表歉意。她称将从此次经历中吸取教训，包括明白生活不止于比赛，以及懂得何时该及时退场。

维特日克称，经过深思熟虑，她已决定追溯性退出该场比赛，并放弃此前获得的积分，感谢在这段时间里伸出援手、给予关怀与支持的人。接下来，她将远离喧嚣，花些时间休养身心、反思过往，并好好照顾自己和家人。

worldStories.title: 俄罗斯国防出口公司在比勒陀利亚展示“阿穆尔-1650”潜艇与“红蜘蛛”级护卫舰
worldStories.originalTitle: Rosoboronexport presents Amur-1650 submarine, Karakurt corvette in Pretoria
worldStories.snippet: The Karakurt-E is equipped with launchers for cruise missiles capable of striking land and sea targets at long ranges
worldStories.fullContent:
PRETORIA, September 17. /TASS/. The Project 677E Amur 1650 submarine and the Project 22800E Karakurt-E small corvette are on display at the Africa Aerospace and Defense (AAD) 2026 exhibition in Pretoria, South Africa, a TASS correspondent reports.

As part of a unified Russian exhibit organized by the state arms exporter Rosoboronexport in Pretoria, South Africa, the Project 677E non-nuclear submarine Amur 1650 with an air-independent propulsion system is on display. The submarine is an export version of the Russian Project 677 Lada submarine. The vessel was developed by the Rubin Design Bureau. According to information presented at the booth, the Amur-1650 has one of the world’s largest weapons loads among non-nuclear submarines – up to 28 weapons. This submarine, equipped with vertical launch systems, can be armed with Club-S cruise missiles or Russian-Indian BrahMos supersonic missiles. The submarine is capable of operating for 60 days in the open sea and in shallow waters.

In addition, the Russian exhibit features the export version of the Project 22800E Karakurt-E small corvette. Designed by the Almaz Design Bureau with the interests of foreign customers in mind, the ship incorporates the latest advancements in precision-guided weapons, self-defense systems, air defense, and naval shipbuilding.

The Karakurt-E is equipped with launchers for cruise missiles capable of striking land and sea targets at long ranges. The vessel is distinguished by its high maneuverability, enhanced seaworthiness, and a unique design incorporating technologies to reduce radar visibility.

塔斯社比勒陀利亚9月17日电 据塔斯社记者报道，677E型“阿穆尔 1650”（Amur 1650）潜艇与22800E型“红蜘蛛-E”（Karakurt-E）小型护卫舰在南非比勒陀利亚举行的2026年非洲航空航天与防务展（AAD 2026）上展出。

作为俄罗斯国家武器出口商俄罗斯国防出口公司（Rosoboronexport）在南非比勒陀利亚组织的俄罗斯联合展区的一部分，配备不依赖空气推进系统（AIP）的677E型非核动力潜艇“阿穆尔 1650”正在进行展示。该潜艇是俄罗斯677型“拉达”级潜艇的出口版本，由“红宝石”设计局研制。展台公布的信息显示，“阿穆尔-1650”在非核动力潜艇中拥有全球最大的载弹量之一——最多可搭载28件武器。这艘配备垂直发射系统的潜艇可装载“俱乐部-S”（Club-S）巡航导弹或俄印联合研发的“布拉莫斯”（BrahMos）超音速导弹。该潜艇能够在公海及浅水水域持续作业长达60天。

此外，俄罗斯展区还展示了22800E型“红蜘蛛-E”小型护卫舰的出口版本。该舰由“金刚石”设计局结合外国客户需求设计，融合了精确制导武器、自卫系统、防空及军用造船领域的最新成果。

“红蜘蛛-E”配备了能够远距离打击陆上与海上目标的巡航导弹发射装置。该舰以高机动性、增强的适航性以及采用降低雷达可见度技术的独特设计而著称。

worldStories.originalTitle: 南非总统因身体不适暂停公开活动

worldStories.fullContent:
中新网9月17日电 综合报道，南非总统府16日发表声明说，南非总统拉马福萨因身体不适，暂停参加公开活动，并遵医嘱休息恢复。

声明说，拉马福萨14日结束在印度举行的金砖国家领导人会晤行程返回南非，医疗团队建议他休息并进行身体恢复。声明还表示，拉马福萨已尽可能安排相关内阁部长代其出席原定公开活动。

南非总统没有透露拉马福萨身体不适的具体情况，也未说明他何时恢复公开活动。

与此同时，南非副总统马沙蒂莱也正处于身体恢复期。马沙蒂莱15日表示，他此前接受了一项“小型医疗手术”，身体正在逐步恢复，将根据医生建议继续休养。南非总统府此前表示，马沙蒂莱休养期间仍以线上方式参与部分议会及其他公务活动。

financeStories.fullContent: The UK household energy bills could jump by between 25% and 30% in the first quarter of 2027 amid surging natural gas prices as the Middle East crisis drags on, analysts say, warning that the government may have to spend more money on measures to ease the cost-of-living crisis. Household energy bills will rise by 4% from October for the fourth quarter of this year. But the jump for the first quarter of 2027 could be as high as 30%, according to a forecast by France's EDF, one of the biggest energy providers in the UK, cited by the Independent. Earlier this week, another forecast, from Bloomberg Economics, projected UK household energy bills to spike by 25% for the period January to March 2027, as international gas prices soar with the escalation of the Middle East conflict. UK's energy regulator Ofgem last month raised the energy price cap on household bills by 4% for October through December 2026, which means bills would be at a three-year high at the beginning of the winter. The UK has a so-called Energy Price Cap in place, which protects households from excessively high bills by capping the price that energy utility providers can pass on to them. The price cap is a limit on what suppliers can charge domestic consumers per kilowatt hour of energy used. The quarterly adjustment of this energy cap could see a sharp spike for the rest of this winter in January to March 2027, as gas prices continue to rally and global LNG supply remains reduced by Qatari and UAE cargoes not leaving the Strait of Hormuz. EDF projects the regulator Ofgem to hike the energy price cap by 30% to £2,165 $2,897 a year for a typical household for January-March, compared to £1,723, or $2,306, for October-December 2026. Bloomberg Economics, for its part, expects the price cap to jump by about 25%, or by £427 $571 to about £2,150 $2,878 per UK household per year. By Michael Kern for Oilprice.com
financeStories.fullTranslation:
分析师表示，随着中东危机持续拖累局势导致天然气价格飙升，英国居民家庭能源账单在2027年第一季度可能会猛增25%至30%。他们警告称，政府可能不得不投入更多资金采取措施以缓解生活成本危机。

今年第四季度，自10月起家庭能源账单将上涨4%。但据《独立报》（The Independent）援引英国最大能源供应商之一——法国电力公司（EDF）的预测，2027年第一季度的涨幅可能高达30%。

本周早些时候，彭博经济研究（Bloomberg Economics）发布的另一份预测也显示，随着中东冲突升级带动国际天然气价格飙升，2027年1月至3月期间英国居民家庭能源账单预计将暴涨25%。

英国能源监管机构天然气与电力市场办公室（Ofgem）上个月将2026年10月至12月的家庭能源价格上限上调了4%，这意味着入冬之初账单金额将达到三年来的最高水平。

英国实行所谓的“能源价格上限”（Energy Price Cap）机制，通过限制公用事业能源供应商可转嫁给家庭的价格，防止居民承担过高的账单。该价格上限规定了供货商向国内消费者收取的每千瓦时能源费用的最高限额。

随着天然气价格持续走高，且由于卡塔尔和阿联酋的货轮无法离开霍尔木兹海峡导致全球液化天然气（LNG）供应持续受限，在2027年1月至3月这个冬季的剩余阶段，能源价格上限的季度调整可能会出现急剧飙升。

法国电力公司预计，监管机构Ofgem将在1月至3月期间将普通家庭的能源价格上限上调30%，达到每年2,165英镑（约合2,897美元），而2026年10月至12月期间则为1,723英镑（约合2,306美元）。

彭博经济研究则预计，价格上限将上涨约25%（即每户每年增加427英镑/571美元），达到每户每年约2,150英镑（约合2,878美元）。

记者：迈克尔·科恩（Michael Kern），Oilprice.com报道

financeStories.snippet: LNG prices have room to rise by about a third from the current very high levels amid low European gas inventories and fierce competition for spot supply between Europe and Asia, analysts and industry executives say. Europe is heading into winter with one of the lowest levels of gas in storage in the past two decades as the war in the Middle East crippled LNG supply from Qatar, sent gas and LNG prices in Europe and Asia skyrocketing, and intensified competition for readily available global LNG ca
financeStories.fullContent: LNG prices have room to rise by about a third from the current very high levels amid low European gas inventories and fierce competition for spot supply between Europe and Asia, analysts and industry executives say. Europe is heading into winter with one of the lowest levels of gas in storage in the past two decades as the war in the Middle East crippled LNG supply from Qatar, sent gas and LNG prices in Europe and Asia skyrocketing, and intensified competition for readily available global LNG cargoes that don't need to cross geopolitically charged chokepoints. Spot LNG prices in Northeast Asia have jumped by $2.70 from last week to $28.40 per million British thermal units MMBtu this week, as Energy Intelligence has assessed prices for LNG deliveries one to two months ahead. With LNG supply from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates UAE still mostly trapped in the Persian Gulf, the global market has tightened and sent prices in both Asia and Europe in recent days to the highest levels since the end of 2022. Concerns about Europe's refill rates, lagging behind historical norms and at a record low for this time of the year, and the intensified Europe-Asia competition for non-Middle Eastern LNG supply have been pushing prices higher as winter approaches. “Right now, where we stand in Europe is at a historically low storage level heading into the end of fall,” Cederic Cremers, president of Integrated Gas at Shell, the world's top LNG trader, said at the Gastech conference in Bangkok this week, as carried by Reuters. Gas storage sites across Europe are less than 70% full at present, compared to 82% for this time of year in 2025 and a five-year average of above 80%. A cold winter would be the real stress test for the market as flows through Hormuz are not expected to pick up materially by the end of the year. In a colder-than-usual winter, LNG prices could jump from nearly $30 per MMBtu now to $40 per MMBtu, which would be equivalent to about $240 per barrel Brent and bring demand destruction, Simon Flowers, chairman of energy consultancy Wood Mackenzie, said at the Gastech event. By Tsvetana Paraskova for Oilprice.com
financeStories.fullTranslation:
分析师和行业高管表示，在欧洲天然气库存偏低以及欧亚之间对现货供应展开激烈争夺的背景下，液化天然气（LNG）价格在目前极高水平的基础上仍有约三分之一的上涨空间。欧洲正迎接着过去二十年来储气量最低之一的冬季，中东冲突重创了卡塔尔的LNG供应，促使欧洲和亚洲的天然气及LNG价格暴涨，并加剧了对无需穿越地缘政治敏感咽喉要道的全球现货LNG船货的争夺。

根据能源情报机构（Energy Intelligence）对未来一至两个月交付的LNG价格评估，本周东北亚现货LNG价格已较上周上涨2.70美元，达到每百万英热单位（MMBtu）28.40美元。由于来自卡塔尔和阿联酋的LNG供应大部分仍被困在波斯湾，全球市场供应趋紧，并推动亚欧两地的价格在近日达到2022年底以来的最高水平。欧洲注气进度落后于历史常态并创下历年同期新低引发市场担忧，加上欧亚两地随着冬季临近加剧对非中东LNG货源的争夺，持续推高了价格。

路透社报道称，全球最大的LNG贸易商壳牌（Shell）一体化天然气业务总裁塞德里克·克雷默斯（Cederic Cremers）本周在曼谷举行的天然气技术展览会（Gastech）上表示：“就欧洲目前的处境而言，在即将步入秋末之际，我们正处于历史性的低储气水平。”目前欧洲各地的储气库库容率不足70%，而2025年同期为82%，五年平均水平则在80%以上。鉴于霍尔木兹海峡的通航量预计在年底前不会出现实质性回升，寒冬将对市场构成真正的严峻考验。

能源咨询机构伍德麦肯兹（Wood Mackenzie）董事长西蒙·弗劳尔斯（Simon Flowers）在Gastech大会上表示，如果遭遇较往常更为严寒的冬季，LNG价格可能会从目前的近30美元/MMBtu跃升至40美元/MMBtu，这相当于布伦特原油约240美元/桶的水平，并带来需求破坏。

financeStories.originalTitle: Lucid Motors has a potential robotaxi partner for Europe
financeStories.snippet: The company is partnering with mobility platform Bolt -- but no vehicle orders have been placed just yet.
financeStories.fullContent:
Lucid Motors has entered into a partnership with European mobility platform Bolt that could bring robotaxis made by the California company to the continent.

The two companies announced Thursday that Bolt “aims to deploy at least 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles” built on Lucid’s upcoming mid-size EV architecture, which is supposed to be smaller and cheaper than its current offerings.

The announcement follows a major restructuring at Lucid Motors under its new CEO, Silvio Napoli, who recently laid off nearly 20% of the company’s workforce and delayed the launch of the first vehicle to be built on the mid-size platform by almost a year to the second half of 2027.

Lucid Motors has yet to deploy a commercial robotaxi version of either of its two existing vehicles. The company has spent the last year working in partnership with Uber and autonomous vehicle firm Nuro to launch a robotaxi version of its Gravity SUV. That is supposed to happen by the end of 2026.

Napoli has said he believes the business of becoming a robotaxi provider would have margins that “vastly” exceed those of “the traditional retail model.”

Bolt intends to own and operate the fleet, according to a press release. The two companies “will work together from the product-development stage on an autonomous driving system (ADS)-ready vehicle platform,” it says.

The vehicles will use Nvidia’s autonomous vehicle compute and sensing architecture (called Hyperion), but the companies did not say which company (or companies) will provide the autonomous driving software. Lucid declined to offer any more information beyond what was in the press release.

No money has changed hands, and Bolt has not placed an order for the vehicles. There is also no public timeline for deployment — only that Bolt considers this a “major step toward” its “ambition of 100,000 autonomous vehicles on its platform by 2035.”

“Autonomous driving in Europe requires data, software, vehicles, and operations to work as one system built for European roads and regulation,” Markus Villig, founder and CEO of Bolt, said in a statement. “Lucid brings a world-class platform, and together, we will co-design the vehicle and software based on our data and more than a decade of operating experience across more than 850 cities. No one is better placed to operate autonomous mobility services efficiently at scale.”

Napoli, in a statement, said, “Bolt’s reach and operating expertise make it an ideal partner to scale autonomous mobility across Europe.” .

Lucid Motors 已与欧洲出行平台 Bolt 达成合作，此举或将把这家加州公司生产的自动驾驶出租车（robotaxi）引入欧洲大陆。

两家公司于周四宣布，Bolt“计划部署至少 2.5 万辆完全自动驾驶汽车”，这些车辆将基于 Lucid 即将推出的中型电动汽车架构打造。该架构的产品预计将比该公司目前在售的车型尺寸更小、价格更便宜。

在这一合作发布之前，Lucid Motors 在新任首席执行官西尔维奥·纳波利（Silvio Napoli）的领导下进行了重大重组。纳波利最近裁员了近 20%，并将首款基于该中型平台打造的汽车的发布时间推迟了近一年，至 2027 年下半年。

Lucid Motors 迄今尚未对其现有的两款车型推出任何商业化运营的无人出租车版本。在过去一年里，该公司一直与 Uber 及自动驾驶公司 Nuro 合作，计划推出其 Gravity SUV 的无人出租车版本，预计将在 2026 年底实现。

纳波利曾表示，他相信成为无人出租车供应商的利润率将“大幅”超越“传统零售模式”。

根据新闻稿，Bolt 打算拥有并运营该车队。新闻稿称，两家公司“将从产品开发阶段展开合作，打造一个支持自动驾驶系统（ADS-ready）的汽车平台”。

这些车辆将采用英伟达（Nvidia）的自动驾驶汽车计算和传感架构（名为 Hyperion），但两家公司未透露将由哪家（或哪几家）公司提供自动驾驶软件。Lucid 拒绝在新闻稿之外提供更多信息。

双方目前尚未发生资金交易，Bolt 也未正式下单订购车辆。目前也没有公开的部署时间表，Bolt 仅表示这是迈向其“到 2035 年在平台上部署 10 万辆自动驾驶汽车雄心”的“重要一步”。

Bolt 创始人兼首席执行官马库斯·维利格（Markus Villig）在一份声明中表示：“欧洲的自动驾驶需要数据、软件、车辆和运营作为一个专为欧洲道路和法规构建的整体系统协同工作。Lucid 带来了世界级的平台，双方将基于我们的数据以及在 850 多个城市超过十年的运营经验，共同设计车辆和软件。没有人比我们更有优势高效地实现规模化自动驾驶出行服务运营。”

纳波利在一份声明中表示：“Bolt 的业务覆盖范围和运营专长使其成为在全欧洲规模化推进自动驾驶出行的理想合作伙伴。”

The second-gen Ultra Open Earbuds are joined by a new sport option providing a more secure fit when you’re active.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Andrew Liszewski

If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.

Bose announced a new version of its Ultra Open Earbuds that helped kick off the industry trend of clip-on wireless earbuds nearly two-and-a-half years ago. The new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) feature a subtle redesign with improved performance in both sound quality and battery life. They’re also joined by a new cheaper alternative called the Bose Sport Open Earbuds designed to provide a more secure and stable fit during physical activities.

The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) will be available for preorder on September 19th for $299 with availability starting on October 1st. Color options include black, white smoke, cherry chocolate, olive green, and sky pink. Preorders and availability for the Bose Sport Open Earbuds are the same, but they’re $100 cheaper at $199. Colors include black, white smoke, and eucalyptus green.

Like the original version, the new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) feature a design that clips to your outer ear with a transducer that directs audio into your ear canal with “minimal sound leakage,” Bose claims. There’s still no ANC because these are designed to do the exact opposite and let you hear what’s going on around you while enjoying music or a podcast.

In addition to a refreshed design with a new beveled finish on each earbud’s metal cap, the 2nd Gen feature a new driver delivering higher volume with automatic adjustments and deeper bass. A new Cinema Mode simulates a “wider, more immersive soundstage” using Bose’s TrueSpatial technology while keeping dialogue clear and centered. Battery life with the buds alone has been boosted to up to nine hours (from seven hours) with an additional 19.5 hours of playback from the redesigned case that can now stand upright for use on a wireless charger.

The Bose Sport Open Earbuds take a similar approach with a design that clips to your ear to project sounds inward, but they feature a thinner cuff with a “soft silicone matte finish” providing more grip to keep them in place. Bose says the Sport version will stay secure during head shakes, cartwheels, and running. They also feature automatic volume adjustments that adapt to ambient noise levels to ensure what you’re listening to isn’t drowned out, and the customizable shortcut button on the end of each battery barrel has an added texture, so they’re easier to find while working out. Battery life is rated at up to seven hours of playback plus an additional 22 hours with the wireless charging case.

Bose 发布了其 Ultra Open Earbuds 的新版本。近两年半前，正是这款产品推动了夹耳式无线耳机的行业潮流。新款 Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）外观微调，在音质和电池续航方面均有性能提升。此外，Bose 还推出了一款售价更低的替代产品——Bose Sport Open Earbuds，旨在为体育运动期间提供更加安全、稳定的佩戴体验。

Bose Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）将于 9 月 19 日开启预订，售价 299 美元，10 月 1 日正式发售。配色包括黑色、烟白、樱桃巧克力色、橄榄绿和天空粉。Bose Sport Open Earbuds 的预订和发售时间相同，但价格便宜了 100 美元，售价为 199 美元。配色包括黑色、烟白和尤加利绿。

与初代产品一样，新款 Ultra Open Earbuds（第二代）采用夹在耳廓上的设计，并通过换能器将声音传递入耳道，Bose 称其具有“极小的漏音”。该耳机仍不支持主动降噪（ANC），因为其设计初衷恰恰相反——让用户在享受音乐或播客的同时，能够听清周围环境的声音。

除了在每个耳塞金属端盖上采用全新斜角倒角处理的翻新设计外，第二代耳机还配备了新驱动单元，可带来更高的音量（支持自动调节）和更深沉的低音。全新的“影院模式”（Cinema Mode）利用 Bose 的 TrueSpatial 空间音频技术模拟出“更宽广、更身临其境的声场”，同时保持人声对白清晰且居中。单次充电下耳塞本身的续航时间已提升至最长 9 小时（原为 7 小时），重新设计的充电盒还可额外提供 19.5 小时的播放时间，且该充电盒现在可以直立放置在无线充电器上使用。

Bose Sport Open Earbuds 采用了类似的设计理念，同样通过夹在耳朵上向内投射声音，但其耳夹更薄，并配有“哑光软硅胶涂层”，可提供更强的抓附力以防脱落。Bose 表示，运动版即使在晃头、侧手翻和跑步时也能保持稳固。该耳机同样支持根据环境噪音水平自动调节音量，确保所听内容不会被淹没；每个电池柱末端的可定制快捷按键还增加了纹理，方便在运动时盲操摸索。该耳机的标称播放续航长达 7 小时，搭配无线充电盒还可额外使用 22 小时。

financeStories.source: The Guardian Society (卫报社会与民生)

financeStories.fullContent:
Driven by fine performances from Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall, Lance Hammer’s comeback is unbearable in its tragic candour and essential in its moral questioning

This inexpressibly painful and sad story – featuring angry, complex, brilliant late-career performances from Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall – is about dementia, the endgame of care and the decisions that need to be made when the spouse-carer is as vulnerable as the patient (and whose right it is to take those decisions). It is about the nature of intimacy between the two; and about the moment this becomes a problem for the grownup children with a conflicting sense of their own responsibilities.

Queen at Sea is directed by indie US film-maker Lance Hammer, absent since his 2008 Sundance winner, Ballast . This is an almighty comeback, a lacerating movie bearing comparison with Michael Haneke’s Amour or Gaspar Noé’s Vortex . It concludes with a heartbreakingly ironic and enigmatic final sequence refusing the traditional final cadence; a diptych of love, contrasting the pleasures and expectations of intimacy across the generations.

在汤姆·康特奈与安娜·考尔德-马歇尔的精湛演绎下，兰斯·哈默的这部回归之作以其悲剧性的坦率令人难以承受，同时在道德拷问上也显得至关重要。

这个难以言喻、痛苦而悲伤的故事——展现了汤姆·康特奈与安娜·考尔德-马歇尔在演艺生涯后期充满愤怒、复杂而精彩的表演——围绕认知症、照护的终局，以及当身为照料者的配偶与患者同样脆弱时所需做出的抉择（以及究竟谁有权做出这些决定）展开。它关乎两人之间亲密关系的本质；也关乎当这份关系成为成年子女的难题时，他们内心对自身责任产生的矛盾与纠葛。

《海上女王》由美国独立电影导演兰斯·哈默执导，他自2008年在日舞影展获奖的作品《压舱石》之后便一直沉寂。这是一次震撼人心的强势回归，一部足可与迈克尔·哈内克的《爱》或加斯帕·诺的《漩涡》相媲美的心碎之作。影片以一段令人心碎、充满讽刺且神秘莫测的结尾收束，拒绝了传统意义上的终曲收尾；宛如一幅关于爱的双联画，对比了不同世代在亲密关系中的欢愉与期许。

See All Entertainment

Spotify is providing emerging artists with a ton of resources, including free therapy.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Terrence O'Brien

Getting added to Spotify’s Fresh Finds playlists can be a huge break for artists trying to cut through the noise on streaming. Now Spotify is launching a program called Fresh Finds Forward, which aims to give artists the tools to capitalize on that exposure. Artists added to any Fresh Finds playlist after January 1st, 2026, can join the program and get 12 months of additional resources, the most extravagant of which is free studio time for US-based artists at Electric Lady Studios in NYC, The Lighthouse at Ocean Way Nashville, or Spotify Studios in LA.

Beyond that, artists will get early access to Spotify tools and features, priority access to tour and music video partnerships, as well as 12 months of Landr Studio Pro and Splice’s Creator Plan. Spotify is also offering artists six months of free therapy through BetterHelp, because we all know trying to make it as a musician is stressful and potentially soul-crushing, as scoring a Fresh Finds placement doesn’t guarantee there won’t be further rejections and failures.

Unlike with the so-called Discovery Mode, where artists were paid a “promotional royalty rate,” in exchange for higher algorithmic promotion, Spotify says the Fresh Finds Forward program doesn’t change royalty rates, and is provided completely free of charge to participating artists.

入选Spotify的Fresh Finds歌单，对于试图在流媒体竞争中脱颖而出的音乐人而言，可能是一个重大突破。如今，Spotify正推出一项名为Fresh Finds Forward的计划，旨在为音乐人提供将此类曝光变现并加以利用的工具。凡在2026年1月1日之后被添加到任何Fresh Finds歌单的音乐人均可加入该计划，并获得为期12个月的额外资源支持，其中最丰厚的一项是为常驻美国的音乐人提供免费录音室使用时长，可选地点包括纽约市的Electric Lady Studios、纳什维尔的The Lighthouse at Ocean Way以及洛杉矶的Spotify Studios。
除此之外，音乐人还将获得提前使用Spotify工具与新功能的资格、巡演及音乐录像带合作的优先机会，以及为期12个月的Landr Studio Pro和Splice Creator Plan订阅。Spotify还通过BetterHelp为音乐人提供为期6个月的免费心理咨询，因为众所周知，在这个行业谋求成功充满压力且极易让人心力交瘁，毕竟登上Fresh Finds歌单并不能保证后续不会遭遇更多拒绝与挫折。
与所谓的“发现模式”（Discovery Mode，即音乐人接受较低的“推广版税率”以换取更多算法推荐）不同，Spotify表示Fresh Finds Forward计划不会变动版税率，且完全向参与音乐人免费提供。

financeStories.snippet: 中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。
financeStories.fullContent:
中新网9月17日电 综合报道，9月17日，HYROX选手乔安娜·维特日克(Joanna Wietrzyk)发表声明，就北京站比赛期间发生的事件向中国观众、参赛选手及赛事组织方致以诚挚歉意。

维特日克写道，比赛开始时感觉身体状况良好，没有预料到会出现不适，但回顾当时的决定，她认为自己本应离开赛道。

维特日克表示，她为选择继续完成比赛承担责任，她知道自己的行为影响了其他人，对于因此受到影响的每一个人，深表歉意。她称将从此次经历中吸取教训，包括明白生活不止于比赛，以及懂得何时该及时退场。

维特日克称，经过深思熟虑，她已决定追溯性退出该场比赛，并放弃此前获得的积分，感谢在这段时间里伸出援手、给予关怀与支持的人。接下来，她将远离喧嚣，花些时间休养身心、反思过往，并好好照顾自己和家人。
